mgmt_bio.text: Alex Norstrom is co-CEO of Spotify Technology SA, sharing the role with Gustav Soderstrom following co-founder Daniel Ek's transition from CEO to Chairman at the end of 2025. Norstrom brings business and commercial expertise, complementing Soderstrom's product and technology background, and both have worked closely with Ek for more than a decade. Under this leadership, capital allocation priorities center on reinvesting in the business for future growth, mostly through internal R&D but also acquisitions, alongside returning excess capital via opportunistic share repurchases.

citations.title: Spotify Announces Leadership Evolution: Daniel Ek to Become Executive Chairman, Alex Norstrom and Gustav Soderstrom to Become Co-CEOs in January 2026

sentences.text: Daniel Ek stepped down as CEO on December 31, 2025, becoming Executive Chairman, with former co-presidents Alex Norstrom (chief business officer) and Gustav Soderstrom (chief product and technology officer) taking over as co-CEOs on January 1, 2026 and joining the board.

sentences.quote: This evolution formalizes how Spotify has successfully operated since 2023 with the co-presidents largely leading strategic development and operational execution of Spotify. As Executive Chairman, Ek's role will more closely reflect a European chairman setup, where he will determine capital allocation, map the long-term future of Spotify and continue to provide support and guidance to its senior team.
sentences.text: Spotify framed this as formalizing how it has operated since 2023, with Ek adopting a European-style chairman role covering capital allocation, long-term strategy and guidance to senior management.
